eyebrow: A query you should be able to read
code:
SELECT gl.period_name, gl.account_code,
       gl.gl_balance, ap.subledger_total,
       (gl.gl_balance - ap.subledger_total) AS variance
FROM   gl_balances gl
JOIN   ap_subledger_summary ap
  ON   gl.account_code = ap.account_code
 AND   gl.period_name  = ap.period_name
WHERE  gl.period_name = 'JAN-26'
 AND   (gl.gl_balance - ap.subledger_total) <> 0;
caption: Returns only the account/period rows where GL and AP subledger totals don't match.
